BiblicalUsage: Reba was one of the five kings of Midian, slain with the sword when Israel avenged itself on Midian, and named among the princes who ruled under Sihon king of the Amorites. His name stands in the record of the vengeance Israel took on Midian for the counsel of Balaam.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the kings of Midian are named so that no enemy of God's people is forgotten, and no judgment of God is left unrecorded.
